content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for PJTAU Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by Professor Jayashankar Telangana Agricultural University (PJTAU) for filling temporary academic positions at its Jagtial campus.

faq.question: Q2. What are the posts available in this PJTAU notification?
faq.answer: The notification invites candidates for Teaching Associate positions in Soil Science and Agricultural Economics, and Part-Time Teacher positions in Agronomy, Agricultural Extension, and Veterinary & Livestock Production.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available under this recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 5 vacancies distributed across different departments for Teaching Associates and Part-Time Teachers.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for Teaching Associate posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Sc or Ph.D in the relevant discipline (such as Soil Science or Agricultural Economics) to apply for the Teaching Associate positions.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for Ph.D holders?
faq.answer: Candidates with a Ph.D qualification will receive a consolidated pay of Rs. 54,000/- per month for the Teaching Associate positions.

faq.question: Q6. What is the remuneration for Part-Time Teachers?
faq.answer: Part-time teachers will be paid Rs. 1,000/- per hour or class, subject to a maximum monthly cap of Rs. 35,000/-.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application and selection?
faq.answer: The selection is purely based on a Walk-in Interview. Candidates do not need to apply online or offline beforehand; they can directly attend the interview.

faq.question: Q8. When is the walk-in interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled to be held on 12-10-2026 starting at 09:00 AM.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the walk-in interview venue located?
faq.answer: The interview will take place at the Office of the Associate Dean, Agricultural College, Polasa, Jagtial, Telangana (Pincode: 505529).

faq.question: Q10. What documents should I bring to the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring two sets of photocopies of original certificates, a bio-data with a self-attested photograph, a No Objection Certificate if currently employed, and other relevant testimonials.
